'''Calindin''' is an [[Taraboner]] [[Accepted]] in [[Salidar]].

== Appearance ==
She has black hair in a multitude of braids.{{ref/book|6|14}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Calindin has a [[One Power]] strength of {{opsl|37}}, making her [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|weak]] for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to [[Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

== History ==
Calindin was born in [[Tarabon]] in {{ne|960}}. She enrolled as a novice in {{ne|977}} and was raised to Accepted in {{ne|989}} after twelve years.

She has been Accepted for more than ten years. She is said to struggle for every scrap she learns, though she had no trouble Linking.

== Activities ==
She is part of the [[Link]] controlled by [[Anaiya]], when the [[Bubble of evil]] erupts in [[Salidar]].

She shared a house with [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]] in Salidar.
